tutorial_title: How do you get the connection details?
test_ok: The connection works. {{platform}} responded, and the key can read products and orders.
gomag_desc: You connect with the API token from your Gomag account. Hontrio only reads your products and orders.
gomag_store_url_hint: The domain your customers use, as set up in Gomag.
gomag_api_key_placeholder: The token from your Gomag account
gomag_step_1_desc: In the Gomag admin, open the details of the store’s main account.
gomag_step_2_desc: It’s in the account’s Token API section. If the section is missing, ask the Gomag team to enable API access.
gomag_step_3_desc: Paste it into the “API token” field and fill in your store’s address.
merchantpro_desc: You connect with an API user that has read-only access to your catalog and orders.
merchantpro_store_url_hint: Your store’s domain, which the MerchantPro API also answers on.
merchantpro_step_1_desc: Sign in to the MerchantPro admin with an account that has Developer access.
merchantpro_step_2_desc: Click “Add API user” and enter “Hontrio” as the internal name.
merchantpro_step_3_title: “Read only” access to catalog and orders
merchantpro_step_3_desc: Read access is all Hontrio needs.
merchantpro_step_4_title: Save and copy the details into Hontrio
merchantpro_step_4_desc: Once saved, the API User and API Secret appear in the API Users table.
opencart_desc: OpenCart doesn’t give access to products and orders out of the box, so Hontrio uses a free extension. The extension only reads data and notes, for each new order, where the customer came from, for example a Google ad.
opencart_download: Download the extension for your OpenCart version
opencart_store_url_hint: If OpenCart is installed in a subfolder, include it (for example https://your-store.com/shop).
opencart_api_key_placeholder: The key from the extension’s page
opencart_step_1_desc: Your OpenCart version is shown in the admin footer (for example 3.0.3.8 or 4.0.2.3).
opencart_step_2_desc: Click “Upload” and choose the archive without renaming it. Then, on OpenCart 4, install the extension with the green + button.
opencart_step_3_desc: Choose “Modules” as the extension type, install the Hontrio module with the green + button, then open it with the blue edit button.
opencart_step_4_desc: Click “Copy” next to “Hontrio key” and paste the key into Hontrio, together with your store’s address.
